ex.en: His home is furnished in a very cozy way.
ex.zh: 他家布置得非常溫馨。

ex.en: The couple spent a lot of money on furnishing their house.
ex.zh: 那對夫婦花了很多錢添購家具布置房子。

ex.en: The apartment comes fully furnished.
ex.zh: 這間公寓附全套家具。

ex.en: The organization furnished the refugees with food.
ex.zh: 那個組織為難民提供了食物。

ex.en: They furnished the library with many books.
ex.zh: 他們為圖書館提供了很多書。

ex.en: We are fundraising for a new library.
ex.zh: 我們正在為新圖書館募款。

ex.en: The students fundraised to pay for the trip.
ex.zh: 學生們募款來支付旅費。

ex.en: These problems will be solved in the near future.
ex.zh: 這些問題在不久的將來都會解決。

ex.en: I want to be a pilot in the future.
ex.zh: 將來我想當飛行員。

ex.en: Who can tell what will happen in the future?
ex.zh: 誰知道未來會發生什麼事？

ex.en: Mrs. Harris is very doubtful about her son's future.
ex.zh: 哈里斯太太對兒子的前途很沒信心。

ex.en: This job has a bright future.
ex.zh: 這份工作很有前途。

ex.en: Let's keep this for future use.
ex.zh: 我們把這個留著以後用吧。

ex.en: We look forward to future orders from you.
ex.zh: 期待您日後繼續訂購。

ex.en: The horse stopped and refused to go any further.
ex.zh: 馬停了下來，不肯再往前走。

ex.en: He was too tired to go any further.
ex.zh: 他太累了，走不動了。

ex.en: Wait, don't go any further. Something feels off here.
ex.zh: 等一下，別再往前走了，這裡感覺不太對勁。

ex.en: Lady Catherine, I have nothing further to say.
ex.zh: 凱瑟琳夫人，我沒有別的話要說了。

ex.en: For further information, please contact us.
ex.zh: 如需進一步資訊，請與我們聯絡。

ex.en: Its modernisation went much further than I had expected.
ex.zh: 它現代化的程度遠遠超乎我的預期。

ex.en: We need to discuss this further.
ex.zh: 我們需要進一步討論這件事。

ex.en: Tom handed the envelope full of cash to Mary.
ex.zh: 湯姆把裝滿現金的信封交給瑪麗。

ex.en: The lakes and rivers, too, are full of fish.
ex.zh: 湖泊和河流裡也都是魚。

ex.en: The restaurant was full, so we went home.
ex.zh: 餐廳客滿了，所以我們就回家了。

ex.en: This tower commands a full view of the city.
ex.zh: 從這座塔上可以看到整個城市的全景。

ex.en: Almost no students get full marks in Chinese classics.
ex.zh: 幾乎沒有學生在中國古典文學拿到滿分。

ex.en: Please write your full name here.
ex.zh: 請在這裡寫上你的全名。

ex.en: No more, thanks. I'm full.
ex.zh: 不用了，謝謝，我吃飽了。

ex.en: I'm too full to eat dessert.
ex.zh: 我太飽了，吃不下甜點。

ex.en: He was arrested for abusing public funds.
ex.zh: 他因濫用公款而被捕。

ex.en: He took US$1 million retirement funds.
ex.zh: 他領走了一百萬美元的退休基金。

ex.en: We don't have enough funds for the project.
ex.zh: 我們沒有足夠的資金做這個專案。

ex.en: The project is funded by the government.
ex.zh: 這個專案由政府資助。

ex.en: Who will fund the new research center?
ex.zh: 誰會出資興建新的研究中心？

ex.en: The function of the brake is to stop the car.
ex.zh: 煞車的功能是讓車子停下來。

ex.en: Memory is an essential function of our brain.
ex.zh: 記憶是大腦的重要功能。

ex.en: The new system is functioning well.
ex.zh: 新系統運作良好。

ex.en: The elevator isn't functioning properly.
ex.zh: 電梯運作不正常。

ex.en: A quadratic function cannot be used here.
ex.zh: 這裡不能用二次函數。

ex.en: In consequence of some badly coded functions, the system is unstable most of the time.
ex.zh: 由於一些寫得很糟的函式，系統大部分時間都不穩定。

ex.en: It's fun to learn slang words in foreign languages.
ex.zh: 學習外語裡的俚語很有趣。

ex.en: It'll be more fun if we do it together.
ex.zh: 我們一起做的話會更好玩。

ex.en: Have fun at the party!
ex.zh: 派對玩得開心！

ex.en: We had a fun day at the beach.
ex.zh: 我們在海邊度過了好玩的一天。

ex.en: She is a fun person to work with.
ex.zh: 跟她一起工作很有趣。

ex.en: Don't make fun of his accent.
ex.zh: 不要取笑他的口音。

ex.en: The kids made fun of my new haircut.
ex.zh: 孩子們取笑我的新髮型。

ex.en: I fully agree with your point of view.
ex.zh: 我完全同意你的觀點。

ex.en: I am fully convinced of your innocence.
ex.zh: 我完全相信你是清白的。

ex.en: All the flights on March 30th were fully booked.
ex.zh: 3 月 30 日的班機全部客滿。

ex.en: That is the funniest joke that I have ever heard.
ex.zh: 這是我聽過最好笑的笑話。

ex.en: The teacher told us a funny story.
ex.zh: 老師跟我們講了一個有趣的故事。

ex.en: Who's the funniest person in your class?
ex.zh: 你們班上最搞笑的人是誰？

ex.en: The milk smells funny.
ex.zh: 牛奶聞起來怪怪的。

ex.en: My computer is making a funny noise.
ex.zh: 我的電腦發出奇怪的聲音。

ex.en: Coal and natural gas are natural fuels.
ex.zh: 煤和天然氣是天然燃料。

ex.en: This heating equipment uses diesel as fuel.
ex.zh: 這台暖氣設備用柴油當燃料。

ex.en: The fuel tank in the car is full.
ex.zh: 車子的油箱是滿的。

ex.en: Recognition fuels progress.
ex.zh: 認可能推動進步。

ex.en: Low interest rates fueled the housing boom.
ex.zh: 低利率助長了房市熱潮。

ex.en: Furthermore, I still don't think this a huge cultural difference.
ex.zh: 而且，我還是不認為這是很大的文化差異。

ex.en: The plan is too expensive. Furthermore, it will take too long.
ex.zh: 這個計畫太貴了，而且也太花時間。

ex.en: The family is the fundamental unit of society.
ex.zh: 家庭是社會的基本單位。

ex.en: Respect for law is fundamental to our society.
ex.zh: 尊重法律是我們社會的根基。

ex.en: Math is fundamental to any science.
ex.zh: 數學是一切科學的基礎。

ex.en: You need to learn the fundamentals first.
ex.zh: 你得先學會基本功。

ex.en: The fundamentals of the economy remain strong.
ex.zh: 經濟的基本面依然強勁。

ex.en: I hope I can get my wish fulfilled.
ex.zh: 希望我的願望能實現。

ex.en: She finally fulfilled her dream of becoming a doctor.
ex.zh: 她終於實現了當醫生的夢想。

fulfill.zh: 履行、滿足（承諾、要求、訂單）

ex.en: The outcome of the test shows that the system has already fulfilled all design requirements.
ex.zh: 測試結果顯示，系統已經符合所有設計要求。

ex.en: We can fulfill your order within three days.
ex.zh: 我們可以在三天內完成您的訂單。

ex.en: The office is simple but functional.
ex.zh: 辦公室很簡單但很實用。

ex.en: The design is both beautiful and functional.
ex.zh: 這個設計既美觀又實用。

ex.en: The elevator is fully functional again.
ex.zh: 電梯又能正常運作了。

ex.en: Is the old printer still functional?
ex.zh: 那台舊印表機還能用嗎？

ex.en: Fundamentally, the formation of the twelve zodiac signs is related to animal worship.
ex.zh: 從根本上說，十二生肖的形成與動物崇拜有關。

ex.en: The two plans are fundamentally different.
ex.zh: 這兩個計畫根本上就不同。

ex.en: We need to fundamentally change the way we work.
ex.zh: 我們必須從根本上改變工作方式。

ex.en: Mushrooms are a type of fungus.
ex.zh: 菇類是一種真菌。

ex.en: The tree was killed by a fungus.
ex.zh: 這棵樹被一種真菌害死了。

ex.en: Jazz fusion is a combination of rock and jazz.
ex.zh: 融合爵士是搖滾樂與爵士樂的結合。

ex.en: The restaurant serves Asian fusion cuisine.
ex.zh: 這家餐廳供應亞洲融合料理。

ex.en: Nuclear fusion powers the sun.
ex.zh: 核融合為太陽提供能量。

ex.en: Scientists hope fusion will provide clean energy.
ex.zh: 科學家希望核融合能提供乾淨能源。

ex.en: There is too much furniture in the house.
ex.zh: 房子裡家具太多了。

ex.en: All the furniture in the room was all worn out.
ex.zh: 房間裡的家具都很舊了。

ex.en: We rented a truck to move our furniture.
ex.zh: 我們租了一輛卡車來搬家具。

ex.en: I feel bad about not having gone to his funeral.
ex.zh: 我因為沒有參加他的葬禮而感到很糟糕。

ex.en: A great many people attended his funeral.
ex.zh: 很多人都參加了他的葬禮。

ex.en: Tom's funeral will be this weekend.
ex.zh: 湯姆的葬禮訂在這週末。

ex.en: She shook with fury when she read the letter.
ex.zh: 她讀完那封信後氣得渾身發抖。

ex.en: His fury was obvious to everyone in the room.
ex.zh: 他的暴怒讓房間裡的每個人都看得出來。

ex.en: When Tom found out about that, he was furious.
ex.zh: 當湯姆發現這件事時，他很生氣。

ex.en: Adam was furious with me when I broke his watch.
ex.zh: 我把亞當的手錶弄壞了，氣得他七竅生煙。

ex.en: Mother will be furious for sure!
ex.zh: 媽媽一定會氣炸的！

ex.en: Amazon has fulfillment centers all over the world.
ex.zh: 亞馬遜在世界各地都有物流中心。

ex.en: Order fulfillment usually takes one to two days.
ex.zh: 訂單出貨通常需要一到兩天。

ex.en: Teaching gives her a sense of fulfillment.
ex.zh: 教書讓她很有成就感。

ex.en: The trip was the fulfillment of a lifelong dream.
ex.zh: 這趟旅行實現了他畢生的夢想。

ex.en: The new version adds more functionality.
ex.zh: 新版本增加了更多功能。

ex.en: The app is simple but has all the functionality you need.
ex.zh: 這個 App 很簡單，但你需要的功能都有。

ex.en: The furnished apartment includes a bed, desk, and sofa.
ex.zh: 這間附家具的公寓備有床、書桌和沙發。

ex.en: They chose a furnished unit because their stay was temporary.
ex.zh: 他們選擇家具齊全的房子，因為只會短期居住。
